summary: BioNTech SE filed a Form 6-K announcing that its Supervisory Board approved appointing KPMG AG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft as independent auditor for fiscal year ending December 31, 2027, subject to shareholder election at the upcoming Annual General Meeting, following a competitive audit tender overseen by the Audit Committee, which unanimously recommended KPMG. No special-situation transaction terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation on a deal, advisor, or regulatory clock are disclosed. This is a routine governance and auditor-rotation update; no risk-arb angle applies.
